part: Doepfer A-100 technical details (bus pinout, -12V red stripe down, 10/16-pin bus, unboxed headers warning) - J-PWR-EURO
notes: Saved HTML of Doepfer's bus/power page. Verbatim (markup stripped): 'the -12V line is marked with a colored wire (typically red) and the colored wire has to be aligned to the bottom of the bus board'; 'Both the 10 pin and the 16 pin version of the bus connection have available the standard power supply (-12V, GND, +12V). In addition the 16 pin version ... has the three signals +5V, CV and Gate'; 'For the connection of the bus cables to the bus the rule is red strip down'; and, bearing on J-PWR-EURO: Doepfer uses 'unboxed headers only, without bowl/box and without code gap' and says 'it's not allowed to use bus boards with polarized pin headers (boxed pin headers with code gap). These force the user to connect the bus cable in a certain direction which may be the wrong one'. The pin-out picture itself is an embedded image not banked here. PSU ratings: A-100PSU3 +12V/2000mA, -12V/1200mA, +5V/4000mA.
